title: Stone Removal Game
summary: Alice and Bob play a game where Alice starts by removing exactly 10 stones.
statement: Alice and Bob play a game where Alice starts by removing exactly 10 stones. On each subsequent turn, a player removes one fewer stone than the previous player. The game concludes when a player is unable to make a move, resulting in their loss. Given a positive integer n, determine whether Alice wins the game.
constraints: Alice and Bob alternate, with Alice first.
The required removal begins at ten stones and decreases by one after every successful turn.
A player unable to remove the required amount loses; return whether Alice wins.
reference_solution:
def does_alice_win_stone_removal(n):
    take=10
    alice=True
    while take>0 and n>=take:
        n-=take
        take-=1
        alice=not alice
    return not alice

hints: Track whose turn follows every successful removal.
Stop when the current player lacks enough stones or the required amount reaches zero.
The player who made the last successful move is the winner.
editorial: The player who made the last successful move is the winner.

tests.explanation: Alice removes ten, leaving two; Bob cannot remove nine, so Alice wins.
Alice cannot make the first ten-stone move and loses.
